cc:Work.dc:title: Misc - WoodHinge
cc:Work.dc:description:
Flat-pack butt hinge: two slotted leaves joined by a loose barrel and pin
Two hinge leaves are joined by a set of barrel rings that thread through alternating knuckle mortises on each leaf's pivot edge. A pin rod locks the rings together. The assembly can rotate freely around the pin axis. Cut all parts from the same sheet; the number of rings equals (2 * knuckles - 1).
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WoodHinge Command line short: boxes WoodHinge
